svg.title: Last-mile delivery
svg.desc: A street corner for last-mile delivery: a bank of parcel lockers with a touchscreen kiosk under a canopy on the sidewalk, a courier hand truck stacked with parcels, a landing pad where a quadcopter drone lowers its parcel, a delivery van parked on the street with a crosswalk, a street lamp, bollards and a planter. The lit locker door swings open to reveal the parcel waiting inside.
